contradictions.what: Rep first named Maya as final decider, then revealed Greg held the contract and signed, revising to a split decision.
Rep thought they were only keeping the incumbent honest, yet the customer's questions shifted to hardware and exit costs, indicating a real switch evaluation.
Rep frames the deal as won at signing, but only memberships and online billing moved; the studio front desks remain with Global.
